Verse 1  
Grab two slices of bread and spread them wide  
Take a spoonful of peanut butter and place it on the top  
Add a dollop of bright yellow jelly on the other side  
Press gently and watch the sandwich rise  

Chorus  
Yum yum yum the perfect snack  
Crispy bread and sweet dreams  

Bridge  
Open the jar and pour the creamy spread  
Stir it well then spread it thin  
Cut the sandwich in half and enjoy
